mukta-m0-p80-v1976.quick_english: One should recite only that mantra by which the binding rite is to be performed.

mukta-m0-p80-v1977.quick_english: Meditating on the soul and placing it properly, not otherwise, prevents it from obstructing success.

mukta-m0-p80-v1978.quick_english: O lord of gods, I desire to hear the supremely wonderful secret.

mukta-m0-p80-v1979.quick_english: O supreme goddess, what of the previously mentioned gems in your absence?

mukta-m0-p80-v1980.quick_english: Gems should be carefully made by those desiring all success.

mukta-m0-p80-v1981.quick_english: The horn-born gems are named from gajahāriṇa, sword, gold, and sāmbara.

mukta-m0-p80-v1982.quick_english: Skull-formed gems are remembered as full of all success.

mukta-m0-p80-v1983.quick_english: The gems named vaiḍūrya, nīla, and kāca give all results.

mukta-m0-p80-v1984.quick_english: O goddess, the kullukā-mālikā vidyā is remembered as subjugating.

mukta-m0-p80-v1985.quick_english: Empowered and bearing the skull of a living being, it is for all success.

mukta-m0-p80-v1986.quick_english: That form, distinguished by that form, accomplishes the desired result.

mukta-m0-p80-v1987.quick_english: Or that which is the triad born from the skull seed in Kālī or Chinnamastā form.

mukta-m0-p80-v1988.quick_english: A garland made only of gems and born only from gems.

mukta-m0-p80-v1989.quick_english: Thus it has been spoken briefly; what else do you desire to hear?

mukta-m0-p80-v1990.quick_english: I will also speak the secret from the standpoint of the form of the letter-seed.

mukta-m0-p80-v1991.quick_english: Recited by him, it should be made as the form of all gods.

mukta-m0-p80-v1992.quick_english: The mātṛkā letter-garland is gem-born or crystal-born.

mukta-m0-p80-v1993.quick_english: The copper garland is for all peace; the sword-born garland gives liberation to ancestors.

mukta-m0-p80-v1994.quick_english: The first, born from Arka's chest, is used in an enemy-expulsion rite.

mukta-m0-p80-v1995.quick_english: The god's image-yantra and divine wheel are especially noted.

mukta-m0-p80-v1996.quick_english: The gem-rich, gold-and-gem-made item should be worn on the finger and in the heart.

mukta-m0-p80-v1997.quick_english: May one become lord of all success; here no deliberation is needed.

mukta-m0-p80-v1998.quick_english: The deity of food is Lakṣmī; in the Vaiṣṇava context, Prajāpati.

mukta-m0-p80-v1999.quick_english: Diamond is known as Varuṇa's; earth is remembered as of liquids.

mukta-m0-p80-v2000.quick_english: For kṛśara, the goddess is Ramā; for paramānna, Kālikā.

mukta-m0-p80-v1976.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mukta-m0-p80-v1976.question: Which mantra should one recite to accomplish the binding rite?
premises: The rite requires a specific mantra.
mukta-m0-p80-v1976.inference: One must recite the mantra by which binding is accomplished.
uncertainties: Exact mantra not specified in this verse.

mukta-m0-p80-v1977.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mukta-m0-p80-v1977.question: What practice prevents the soul from becoming an obstacle to success?
premises: Meditation on the soul is required.
mukta-m0-p80-v1977.inference: Proper meditation and placement of the soul avoids obstructing success.
uncertainties: Exact placement method not detailed here.

mukta-m0-p80-v1978.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mukta-m0-p80-v1978.question: What secret does the devotee wish to hear from the lord of gods?
premises: The speaker addresses the lord of gods.
The desired thing is secret and wonderful.
mukta-m0-p80-v1978.inference: The devotee asks to hear a supremely wonderful secret.
uncertainties: The secret itself is not named here.

mukta-m0-p80-v1979.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mukta-m0-p80-v1979.question: What happens to the previously mentioned gems in the goddess's absence?
mukta-m0-p80-v1979.inference: The verse raises the status of those gems when the supreme goddess is absent.
uncertainties: The exact consequence is not stated in this verse.

mukta-m0-p80-v1980.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mukta-m0-p80-v1980.question: How should gems be made by those desiring all success?
mukta-m0-p80-v1980.inference: Those desiring all success should carefully make the gems.
uncertainties: Specific gem-making method is not given here.

mukta-m0-p80-v1981.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mukta-m0-p80-v1981.question: What kind of horn-born gems are named from gajahāriṇa, sword, gold, and sāmbara?
mukta-m0-p80-v1981.inference: These horn-born gems are identified by that compound name.
uncertainties: The full ritual use is not stated here.

mukta-m0-p80-v1982.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mukta-m0-p80-v1982.question: What are the skull-formed gems remembered to be full of?
premises: They are full of all success.
mukta-m0-p80-v1982.inference: Skull-formed gems are remembered as full of all success.
uncertainties: No ritual procedure is given here.

mukta-m0-p80-v1983.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mukta-m0-p80-v1983.question: What results do the vaiḍūrya-nīla-kāca named gems give?
premises: The gems are named by materials.
mukta-m0-p80-v1983.inference: These named gems give all results.
uncertainties: No further specification of results.

mukta-m0-p80-v1984.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mukta-m0-p80-v1984.question: What is the kullukā-mālikā vidyā remembered to do?
premises: It is addressed to the goddess.
mukta-m0-p80-v1984.inference: The kullukā-mālikā vidyā is remembered as subjugating.
uncertainties: Exact subjugation target is not stated.

mukta-m0-p80-v1985.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mukta-m0-p80-v1985.question: What empowered form is for all success and bears a living being's skull?
premises: The form bears a living being's skull.
mukta-m0-p80-v1985.inference: An empowered form bearing a living being's skull is for all success.
uncertainties: Exact deity form is not named.

mukta-m0-p80-v1986.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mukta-m0-p80-v1986.question: What does the form distinguished by that form accomplish?
premises: A form is distinguished by that form.
It is specified by a relative pronoun.
mukta-m0-p80-v1986.inference: The form so distinguished accomplishes the desired result.
uncertainties: The exact result is context-dependent.

mukta-m0-p80-v1987.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mukta-m0-p80-v1987.question: Which triad is born from the skull seed in Kālī or Chinnamastā form?
premises: The form is Kālī or Chinnamastā.
It is born from the skull seed.
mukta-m0-p80-v1987.inference: The triad born from the skull seed appears in Kālī or Chinnamastā form.
uncertainties: The three members are not listed here.

mukta-m0-p80-v1988.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mukta-m0-p80-v1988.question: What garland is made only of gems and born only from gems?
premises: The garland is made only of gems.
It is born only from gems.
mukta-m0-p80-v1988.inference: The garland is exclusively gem-made and gem-born.
uncertainties: No ritual use is specified.

mukta-m0-p80-v1989.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mukta-m0-p80-v1989.question: After this brief statement, what else does the listener wish to hear?
premises: The listener is asked what else he desires to hear.
mukta-m0-p80-v1989.inference: The verse asks what further teaching the listener wants.
uncertainties: The answer is not in this verse.

mukta-m0-p80-v1990.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mukta-m0-p80-v1990.question: From what standpoint will the speaker also reveal the secret?
premises: The standpoint is the form of the letter-seed.
mukta-m0-p80-v1990.inference: The secret will be revealed from the standpoint of the letter-seed's form.
uncertainties: The secret content is not yet given.

mukta-m0-p80-v1991.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mukta-m0-p80-v1991.question: What should be made by him who recites, and what form does it take?
premises: It takes the form of all gods.
mukta-m0-p80-v1991.inference: He who recites should make the form of all gods.
uncertainties: The exact object to be made is not specified.

mukta-m0-p80-v1992.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mukta-m0-p80-v1992.question: What letter-garland is gem-born or crystal-born?
mukta-m0-p80-v1992.inference: The mātṛkā letter-garland is gem-born or crystal-born.
uncertainties: No ritual application is stated.

mukta-m0-p80-v1993.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mukta-m0-p80-v1993.question: What are the copper and sword-born garlands for?
premises: One is for all peace and one gives liberation to ancestors.
mukta-m0-p80-v1993.inference: The copper garland is for all peace, and the sword-born garland gives liberation to ancestors.
uncertainties: Whether these are the same garland is unclear.

mukta-m0-p80-v1994.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mukta-m0-p80-v1994.question: What is the first thing born from Arka's chest used for?
premises: Something is born from Arka's chest.
It is used in an enemy-expulsion rite.
mukta-m0-p80-v1994.inference: The first item born from Arka's chest is used in an enemy-expulsion rite.
uncertainties: The item itself is not named.

mukta-m0-p80-v1995.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mukta-m0-p80-v1995.question: What image-yantra and divine wheel belong especially to the god?
premises: A divine wheel is mentioned especially.
mukta-m0-p80-v1995.inference: The god's image-yantra and divine wheel are especially noted.
uncertainties: No construction details are given.

mukta-m0-p80-v1996.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mukta-m0-p80-v1996.question: Where should the gem-rich, gold-and-gem-made item be worn?
premises: It is made of gold and gems.
It should be worn on the finger and in the heart.
mukta-m0-p80-v1996.inference: The item should be worn on the finger and in the heart.
uncertainties: Whether one item or two is unclear.

mukta-m0-p80-v1997.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mukta-m0-p80-v1997.question: Why is no deliberation needed when one becomes lord of all success?
premises: One may become lord of all success.
mukta-m0-p80-v1997.inference: When one becomes lord of all success, no deliberation is needed.
uncertainties: The exact condition for becoming so is not stated.

mukta-m0-p80-v1998.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mukta-m0-p80-v1998.question: Which deities are associated with food in Vaiṣṇava and other contexts?
premises: Prajāpati is named in the Vaiṣṇava context.
mukta-m0-p80-v1998.inference: Lakṣmī and Prajāpati are associated with food, the latter especially in Vaiṣṇava context.
uncertainties: The exact division of contexts is compressed.

mukta-m0-p80-v1999.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mukta-m0-p80-v1999.question: What is known as diamond of Varuṇa and what is remembered as earth of liquids?
mukta-m0-p80-v1999.inference: Diamond is known as Varuṇa's, and earth is remembered as belonging to liquids.
uncertainties: The exact cosmological mapping is not explained.

mukta-m0-p80-v2000.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mukta-m0-p80-v2000.question: Which goddess is paired with kṛśara and which with paramānna in this food-deity list?
mukta-m0-p80-v2000.inference: The verse assigns Ramā to kṛśara and Kālikā to paramānna.
uncertainties: exact dish denoted by kṛśara is not specified here
paramānna scope is not further defined here
